error: Could not save. Please try again.
invalid: Enter a valid number within the supported range.
invalidDate: Enter a real date, today or earlier.
cameraPermissionDenied: Camera access is required to take a photo. Enable it in your device settings.
deleteConfirm: Delete this record? This cannot be undone.
needBody: Add body fat or the measurements needed for your equation.
needWeight: Add a weight to get started.
photoEmpty: Add front, side or back photos to see your progress.
photoPermission: Allow photo access in your device settings.
healthUnavailable: Health sync requires a native development build and a supported health provider.
syncFailed: Sync did not finish. Check health permissions and try again.
healthPrivacy: Weight and height sync both ways. Recorded body fat is exported on both platforms; waist circumference is also exported to Apple Health. Other tape measurements and calculated estimates stay in the app.
trendHelp: A daily average smoothed with a 7-day half-life. Early trends are provisional.
bodyHelp: Used to estimate body fat. Adult estimates. Male: neck and abdomen at the navel. Female: neck, natural waist and hips. Measure with a relaxed tape.
localPhotos: Photos are stored privately on this device. Deleting the app may remove them.
syncHelp: Sync imports available health history and exports app records. Imported records remain managed by their source. HealthKit may hide records if read access is denied.
syncSchedule: Syncs daily when allowed by your device, and when you open the app if overdue. Background timing depends on system settings.
metricChooseReference: Choose a formula in Settings for context
bmiContext: Adult weight-for-height screening; muscle can raise BMI.
bodyFatContext: Adult body-fat guide; age and individual needs vary.
ffmiContext: Lean mass relative to height; approximate adult reference, not a target.
shoulderWaistRatioContext: Shoulder ÷ waist circumference. A physique goal, not a health cutoff.
